scope: Read-only final inspection of scoped signing resumption, coordinator/UI/diagnostics and root-produced focused evidence; reviewer did not execute Maven, app, signer, API or process commands.

previousFinding.title: Single-pipeline resume previously cleared the shared shop block
previousFinding.fix: The coordinator now calls authorizePipelineResumption, which never removes the shop block/cause and grants only (shop,pipeline) at the current per-shop object generation.

checks: Resume grants require both matching shop/pipeline context and object-identity equality with the current shop pause generation.
An unvisited sibling remains blocked even if it already has old pipeline or shop authorization, because its grant has no matching resumption generation.
Read-only authentication without a matching pipeline does not receive a scoped exemption from a blocked shop.
A fresh actual CryptoProException swaps the shop generation object, invalidating earlier grants, including a grant captured before the failure but stored after it.
A denied/deferred sibling exits before the provider try/catch, so it does not rotate the epoch or revoke the selected pipeline grant merely by polling.
A separate shop has a separate generation, block and diagnostic cause.
Original authorizePipeline/authorizeShop retain their existing global authorization/unblock semantics; they only clear newly introduced scoped grants as housekeeping.
SigningDeferredException continues to expose operational CANCELLED. Historical provider cause remains only the safe enum-based message.
No new refresh/background code calls authorizePipelineResumption; it is reached from the foreground saved-lot action after license/original-profile/signature gates.
Resume still uses the saved pipeline ID and original settings, keeps order/request/checkpoints, and does not enqueue a new purchase.
UI existing introduction-failure retry, captured coordinator/pipeline, shop-generation callback protection, and paused-buy disabling remain intact.
concurrencyBoundary: Generation revocation applies to subsequent gate admissions. It does not abort a signing operation already admitted/in flight; existing per-certificate serialization and different-certificate concurrency remain unchanged.

rootExecutedEvidence.note: The root/other agents executed the tests. This reviewer only read the saved receipt/XML; full Linux verification is separately running and is not asserted passed here.

limits: No live paid KIZ purchase or seller signing was verified by this reviewer.
No claim of all-app absence of bugs; conclusions are limited to the reviewed diff and saved focused evidence.
The source ZIP is not a Latest publication; no refactor/regression tool integration was approved or installed.
